name: sd-sandbox
description: Open source Stable Diffusion examples and workflows for Ryzen AI software

paragraphs: AMD SD Sandbox is a framework for running Stable Diffusion (SD) models accelerated by AMD Ryzen AI hardware. It supports two NPU platforms, Strix (STX) and Medusa (MDS), from a single codebase and this single README; wherever the two differ, the section is labeled by platform. Medusa is a limited engagement and is not publicly available. It provides an easy-to-use interface for evaluating, comparing, and deploying multiple SD pipelines. When developing AI-powered applications with SD, developers face several challenges:
features: 🎯 What is This? - Overview and introduction
📜 Supported Models - List of supported SD models
🏞️ Image Generation Methods - Description of text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, removal, outpainting
📐 Hardware Prerequisites - AMD hardware requirements (Strix and Medusa)
🚀 Quick Start - Installation process: get up and running

requirements.text: Supported models are downloaded from the Hugging Face Hub on first use, so you need to authenticate your machine with a Hugging Face access token.
Log in from your terminal using the Hugging Face CLI (hf), which ships with the huggingfacehub package:
Paste your token when prompted (or run it non-interactively with hf auth login --token ).
